FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.title: Scrap Ooze
FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.pages.INITIAL.descript:
You spot an ooze that has eaten an array of junk. However, something shines from within...

Should you reach into the dangerous slime for it?
FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.pages.REACH.descriptio:
[red][jitter]Ouch![/jitter][/red]

After rummaging through the metal and burning acid, you finally grab hold of a [gold]relic[/gold] and yank it out.

You pull your way out of the ooze [red]damaged[/red] but rewarded.
FORGE-SCRAP_SLIME.pages.STUDY.descriptio: Examining the Ooze, it eventually leads you towards a compartment with a potion!
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.title: Sputtering Furnace
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.INITIAL.d: You find a furnace sputtering and clinging to heat. The flames brighten as you draw near, beckoning you.
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.INITIAL.o: [green]Remove 1 card from your Deck.[/green] [red]Randomly remove another from your Deck.[/red]
[green]Upgrade a random card in your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 3 Max HP.[/red]
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.FEED.desc:
As you feed it, the flames [red][jitter]ROAR[/jitter][/red] to life!

You may have overfed it a little...
FORGE-SPUTTERING_FURNACE.pages.USE.descr: You decide to use the last of its flames to work. The heat is intense, but you manage to make use of it.
FORGE-GHOST_COUNCIL.title: Council of Ghosts
FORGE-GHOST_COUNCIL.pages.INITIAL.descri:
Thick black smog billows from vents, filling the room in darkness. Out of the smog, three masked apparitions appear.

Each of them beckon to you with promises of a gift, even as they bicker amongst themselves.
FORGE-GHOST_COUNCIL.pages.SCHEME.descrip:
You reach your hand to the spindly apparition, and as it enters you, memories of plots and schemes fill your head.

Oh yes. The things you shall do when you reach the top...
FORGE-GHOST_COUNCIL.pages.PLAY.descripti: The larger apparition laughs, and as it phases into you, you feel your body stiffen and joints crack, as you feel yourself... [jitter][red]Growing.[/red][/jitter]
FORGE-GHOST_COUNCIL.pages.CAPTURE.descri:
The apparition with an oversized grin laughs, and as it phases through you, you feel your vision fade into black...

When you come to, you feel sapped, with a curious bottle filled with 2 ghosts in it...
FORGE-GREMLIN_CONTRACTOR.title: Gremlin Contractor
FORGE-GREMLIN_CONTRACTOR.pages.INITIAL.d:
You come across a well dressed Gremlin, clasping their hands. They introduce themselves as a quality assurance contractor.

"Hello, good person! I'm an independent quality assurance contractor! For a price, I can ensure your equipment is up to code!"
FORGE-GREMLIN_CONTRACTOR.pages.TRIAL.des:
The Gremlin beams at you as you sign up for the trial.

"See? No commitment! And look at you, already feeling better!"
The Gremlin eagerly takes your gold and begins inspecting your deck.

"Don't worry. I'll make sure everything is thoroughly tested."
FORGE-GREMLIN_CONTRACTOR.pages.DELUXE.de:
The Gremlin's eyes widen as you hand over the gold.

"The Deluxe package! Now [jitter][gold]that's[/gold][/jitter] quality assurance!"
FORGE-POTIONOMICAL.title: Potionomical
FORGE-POTIONOMICAL.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
Following a pungent scent brings you to a room of spoiled potions. The notes of whoever used to be here remain...

As you skim through the notes, it looks like they were trying to make something. You eye your current potion.
FORGE-POTIONOMICAL.pages.EXPERIMENT.desc: You carefully follow the instructions, mixing your potion alongside the remains. With a poof and a puff, you find a new item ready to be utilized!
FORGE-POTIONOMICAL.pages.BREW_IT.descrip:
You decide to collect what remains of the experiment.

The result is... questionable, but it should do the job.
